records.title: ActMem: Bridging the Gap Between Memory Retrieval and Reasoning in LLM Agents
records.reason: ActMem improves the link between retrieved memory and LLM reasoning in agents, matching the linked agent-memory lineage. The reviewed method/results establish memory-conditioned reasoning benefits but do not provide a concrete inference latency/token/compute reduction, so scope relevance to inference efficiency remains weak.

records.title: MedSAM-Agent: Empowering Interactive Medical Image Segmentation with Multi-turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: MedSAM-Agent uses multi-turn RL to improve interactive medical segmentation. The primary text explicitly notes iterative interaction increases cumulative inference latency and positions efficiency architecture/sampling as future work; this paper does not supply that optimization.
